content: A blind person who sees their own fault is far wiser than a king who sees only his golden crowns.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: Physical sight is a minor biological gift compared to the internal eye of self-discernment. A crowned ruler intoxicated by power and surrounded by sycophants walks in pitch darkness, while the humble beggar who recognizes their own pride possesses true celestial illumination.
practicalInsight: Look within and honestly acknowledge one personal flaw today without defensiveness. True vision begins at home.
reflectionPrompt: What blind spot in your own behavior have you been ignoring while critiquing the faults of others?
